items.title: Global Indirect Tax Lead
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Tax team's mission is to proactively manage our global tax footprint while supporting Robinhood’s mission to democratize finance for all! We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams to navigate complex tax regulations and enable business growth. Our team values deep collaboration, technical excellence, and proactive problem-solving. We maintain a high-performing, supportive culture where every team member is encouraged to challenge the status quo. As the Manager, Global Indirect Tax, you will lead our global indirect tax compliance, controversy, transaction advisory, and operations initiatives. You will manage end-to-end global indirect tax operations, including compliance, audits, system improvements, and technical research and advisory. You will play a critical role in shaping our overall indirect tax strategy and compliance framework for innovative products and business models. This is a unique opportunity to build scalable tax processes in a fast-growing financial services environment, spearheading the next generation of tax operations through automation and AI-enabled solutions. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Oversee global indirect tax operations, including VAT, GST, sales and use tax, and other non-income transactional tax compliance, registrations, return filings, and payment processes across relevant jurisdictions Manage indirect tax audits and notices, acting as the primary point of contact for tax authorities to resolve assessments and disputes Provide clear technical tax advice regarding indirect tax implications for new products, acquisitions, contracts, cross-border transactions, and business reorganizations Partner cross-functionally to support taxability determinations, invoicing requirements, exemption documentation, and implementation of indirect tax requirements or process improvements in systems and operational processes Monitor legislative and regulatory developments affecting global indirect tax and translate those developments into practical guidance, risk mitigation, and process updates What you bring A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) 8+ years of tax experience, including substantial indirect tax experience within a multinational corporate environment Hands-on experience with global indirect tax compliance, audits, and operational support across multiple jurisdictions, including successful resolution of controversy matters with tax authorities A proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing a team of tax professionals Proficiency in analyzing financial data and working with corporate tax systems or tax determination software; experience driving automation initiatives to improve process efficiency is preferred Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, changing work environment and are able to manage competing priorities with sound judgment and strong execution What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $140,000 — $165,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $123,000 — $145,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $110,000 — $129,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

You’ll plan and run a wide range of events, from research conferences to Scale-hosted executive dinners and practitioner meetups, and support our annual flagship conference, the AI Leadership Summit. You will join a rapidly growing team with the opportunity to manage and execute events from start to finish, drive lead generation, pipeline growth, and brand awareness, and plan event programming with the largest names in AI. What you’ll do Execute end-to-end planning and logistics for executive dinners, meetups, happy hours, sponsored research conferences and trade shows, and virtual events. Design event programs that support sales goals, pipeline growth, and deal acceleration. Support event logistics for our annual flagship conference, the AI Leadership Summit. Manage event budgets and relationships with event production firms, contractors, and outside vendors. Partner with growth marketing on campaigns and MQL reporting. Work with external executives and their teams to secure speakers and support their presentation planning. A strong sense of what white-glove service looks like and the attention to detail to deliver it. items.title: Head of Business Risk & Controls
items.description: About MoonPay MoonPay is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. About the Opportunity MoonPay is strengthening its control environment as part of its long-term strategy to build a robust, scalable, and compliant platform at the intersection of financial services and digital assets. We are hiring a Head of Business Risk & Controls to build and lead a strong first-line risk and control framework across relevant areas of our business. This is an opportunity for an experienced financial services controls leader to build and scale a control environment in a fast-evolving industry. You will be responsible for ensuring that risks are effectively identified, appropriate controls are designed and implemented, and their effectiveness is continuously monitored as MoonPay grows. The role will have a particular focus on fiduciary, custody, and regulated financial services activities, requiring significant experience operating within the US banking environment and a strong working knowledge of applicable regulatory and supervisory expectations. You will work closely with business leaders and with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and other control functions to establish clear accountability, strengthen first-line ownership, and build a control environment capable of supporting an increasingly complex financial services business. What You Will Do Build and own the first-line risk and control framework across relevant MoonPay activities, including risk and control assessments, control standards, documentation, governance, issue management, and ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness. Embed effective controls into business processes, translating regulatory requirements, policies, identified risks, and supervisory expectations into practical and sustainable controls with clear ownership and accountability. Establish a robust control monitoring and testing program, identifying control weaknesses, assessing their impact, driving remediation, and providing clear reporting on the effectiveness of the control environment. Develop the control framework supporting fiduciary, custody, and other regulated financial services activities, ensuring appropriate governance, processes, controls, and monitoring are embedded throughout the relevant business activities. Partner effectively across the three lines of defence, working with business leaders and independent Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams to establish clear roles, effective challenge, timely remediation, and strong first-line ownership. Build for scale and increasing complexity, establishing the procedures, governance, reporting, systems, and operating cadence required to maintain a robust control environment as MoonPay evolves. About You You bring 10+ years of relevant experience within US banking or regulated financial services, including significant leadership experience in first-line risk, business controls, operational risk, or a comparable control function. You have a proven track record as a builder and operator, with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and improving first-line control frameworks spanning risk assessments, control design, monitoring and testing, issue management, remediation, and governance. You have deep working knowledge of US banking regulation and supervisory expectations, with meaningful experience supporting fiduciary, trust, custody, transaction services, or closely related banking activities. You have a strong understanding of the three lines of defence model and experience establishing effective first-line ownership while partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and senior business stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in a high-ambiguity, fast-scaling environment, combining strong technical judgement with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and personally drive the development of robust control infrastructure from the ground up. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Sales team partners with advertisers to understand their businesses, develop meaningful advertising solutions, and drive long-term growth on the platform while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity. About the Role This role will focus on growing advertising revenue across the Financial Services vertical, including banks, credit card issuers, insurance providers, investment and wealth management firms, lending platforms, fintech companies, and adjacent financial services brands. You will own the full sales cycle—from prospecting through deal closure—and build strategic relationships with senior financial services decision-makers. You’ll help advertisers reach high-intent audiences, improve campaign performance, and develop long-term commercial partnerships that support their business goals. You will work closely with Account Managers and cross-functional partners to ensure successful advertiser outcomes after the sale, while maintaining primary ownership of revenue growth, commercial strategy, and Financial Services vertical expertise. In this role, you will: - Prospect, qualify, and close new advertising opportunities across the Financial Services vertical. - Own and achieve a defined revenue target across an assigned portfolio of financial services advertisers. - Build relationships with senior advertising, marketing, digital acquisition, product, and business leaders. - Develop account plans that connect advertiser goals—such as account openings, credit card applications, insurance quotes, qualified leads, app adoption, and customer retention—to measurable campaign outcomes. - Identify opportunities across major financial services moments, including product launches, tax season, annual enrollment periods, and shifts in consumer financial needs. - Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements. - Build clear, data-driven business cases that demonstrate advertiser ROI and long-term platform value. - Partner with Account Managers to support seamless post-sale transitions, campaign success, renewals, and expansion. - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to support complex deals and inform future advertising solutions. - Partner with advertisers and internal teams to navigate industry-specific advertising, privacy, and compliance requirements. - Maintain strong pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and a deep understanding of Financial Services industry trends. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 10+ years of experience in digital advertising, performance marketing, client strategy, consulting, or enterprise sales. - Have experience working with Financial Services advertisers, such as banks, credit card issuers, insurance providers, investment and wealth management firms, lending platforms, or fintech companies. - Have 3+ years of experience advising and influencing senior executives and client stakeholders. - Have a proven track record of owning revenue targets and closing complex advertising or commercial deals. - Understand financial services customer journeys, acquisition funnels, customer lifetime value, and performance metrics. - Have experience navigating the advertising, privacy, and compliance considerations of a regulated industry. - Can create compelling business cases and translate advertiser objectives into measurable partnership strategies. - Have strong verbal and written communication skills. - Can operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments. - Are excited to help shape a new advertising platform while maintaining high standards for user experience, trust, and responsible growth. items.title: Product & Technology Communications Manager
items.location_text: San Francisco, London, New York, Berlin, Toronto
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. The company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine. This is an opportunity to define the narratives that influence how enterprises, developers, and the broader ecosystem understand the future of AI and Cohere’s role in building it. In this cross‑functional, individual‑contributor role, you’ll partner deeply with product, research, engineering, and go‑to‑market teams to translate complex technical work into clear, compelling stories. You’ll help Cohere articulate what we’re building, why it matters, and how our technology is reshaping enterprise AI. You’ll craft narratives that resonate with technical and non‑technical audiences alike, and build programs that elevate Cohere’s product leadership and technical credibility. This is a rare opportunity to build a product and technology communications function at a fast-growing company in the most dynamic space in technology. This is a role for someone who takes great joy at distilling technically complex ideas into mainstream messages that can be understood by all media globally. As Product & Technology Communications Manager, you will: - Develop product and technology communications strategies that support Cohere’s business goals, product roadmap, and technical differentiation - Partner with product, engineering, research, and modeling leaders to craft messaging, narratives, and materials that explain Cohere’s technology in accessible, high-impact ways - Lead communications around product launches, including messaging frameworks, FAQs, press releases, and executive talking points - Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content for customers, partners, analysts, and media - Collaborate with corporate comms to drive proactive storytelling that elevates Cohere’s technical leadership and product momentum - Work closely with marketing to ensure consistency across product marketing, developer content, and external communications - Support thought leadership for product, research, and modeling executives - Use qualitative and quantitative insights to refine messaging and understand what resonates with technical audiences - Prepare and support crisis and issues communications related to product, security, or technical incidents, partnering with Corporate Communications and relevant teams You may be a good fit if you: - Have 5–7 years of experience in product and technology communications, or technical content — ideally in AI, enterprise software, or developer‑focused environments - Are an exceptional writer with a talent for simplifying complex technical topics without losing nuance - Have experience partnering with product and engineering leaders and can operate as a trusted advisor - Understand enterprise AI, machine learning, or developer ecosystems and are eager to go deeper - Are highly organized and detail‑oriented with strong project management skills and a bias for action - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and thrive in fast‑moving, high‑growth environments - Have experience with product launches, technical content development, or developer‑focused communications - Build strong cross‑functional relationships to drive clarity, consistency, and alignment across teams FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Product Delivery Manager
items.description: We are looking for a skilled Product Delivery Manager to join our External Platforms team. The Wow You will own the product backlog , definition of requirements and day-to-day product delivery for an assigned brand /s , working closely with internal stakeholders and 3rd party platform partners. The role combines product ownership, delivery management and supplier management , requiring someone who can work independently, make sound decisions and take initiatives from idea through to production. A taster of what you will be involved with: Own and prioritise the product backlog , balancing business value, customer impact, complexity, effort and product strategy. Define and refine product requirements , working with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for the 3rd party platform. Bring a commercial mindset to product decisions , understanding the impact on customers and the business and challenging ideas where appropriate. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external platform partners , maintaining clear communication, alignment and accountability. Own delivery with the 3rd party platform , agreeing timelines, tracking progress and proactively managing risks, dependencies and blockers. Hold the 3rd party platform accountable for delivery commitment and quality , constructively challenging proposed solutions, managing underperformance and escalating through established governance processes where necessary. Coordinate release readiness with Product, QA and relevant stakeholders, ensuring deliverables are ready for UAT and production. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the product and customer experience , using data, customer behaviour, feedback and business insights to investigate problems, propose solutions and drive improvements through to delivery. What we are looking for At least 5 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Delivery, Project Management or a similar role . Commercially minded , with an understanding of how product decisions impact customers and the wider business. Comfortable owning and prioritising a product backlog , making day-to-day product decisions independently while aligning with business objectives and stakeholder priorities. Strong stakeholder management, communication and ownership skills , with the ability to drive initiatives through to completion. Pragmatic and solution-oriented , able to balance business needs, customer experience, technical constraints and 3rd party platform capabilities. Good analytical and problem-solving skills , with the ability to use data and customer insights to support decisions. You will be expected to make use of analytical tools such as Google Analytics and FullStory amongst others to understand customer problems and bring forward solutions. Good technical understanding , with the ability to understand platform capabilities, integrations, dependencies and technical constraints. Assertive and resilient in supplier management , able to maintain constructive relationships while holding 3rd party partners to agreed commitments, creating urgency and escalating decisively when delivery or quality falls short. A strong agile mindset , proactive attitude and confidence to challenge and find practical solutions. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills . Lithuanian is a strong advantage. What would be an advantage Experience in the iGaming industry . Experience working with 3rd party PAM, sportsbook, other gaming technology platforms . Experience managing external technology suppliers or platform partners. Experience working with analytics tools What we offer Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. Challenge accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.description: About us: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 200 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1000 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe, Asia, and the US, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association . In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification . EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Middle Business Analyst to join our team in Lviv! What You'll get to do: Collaborate with various departments to ensure seamless integration of processes and systems. Analyze and define requirements for player bonus schemes, ensuring they align with business objectives and regulatory standards. Work closely with project stakeholders to gather and document requirements, and to develop effective business solutions. Facilitate communication between technical teams and other departments to ensure clear understanding and implementation of requirements. Create and maintain detailed project documentation, including process flows, functional specifications, and user stories. Participate in the development and refinement of business processes and system improvements. Assist in the monitoring and reporting of project progress, and in addressing any issues that may arise. What you need to know: At least 4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in the iGaming industry or a related field. Experience in managing projects related to system integrations and player bonus systems. Strong ability to create and interpret UML diagrams and wireframes. Proven ability to create and interpret BPMN diagrams, process flowcharts, and process mapping documentation. Experience with AI-driven process automation and optimization. Ability to lead the design of new business processes. Experience facilitating discovery meetings and workshops with subject matter experts and stakeholders across departments. Ability to interpret complex data and business metrics and communicate insights to relevant stakeholders. Experience creating and maintaining detailed process documentation, including process flows, procedures, and policies. Proficiency in preparing and delivering presentations. Solid understanding of business process and system requirements methodologies. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Ability to work effectively in a team and independently. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required; 30 medical leave days with medical allowance Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment with 80/20 office/home format until the end of 2026. Starting from 2027, the policy will transition to primarily office-based work, with up to 10 work-from-home days per year with manager approval. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business, LinkedIn Learning or O’Reilly, and a budget for external training. Gym allowance. Corporate English lessons. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include on-site massages and frequent team-building activities in various locations. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference!

We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Junior QA Engineer to join our team in Lviv! What You'll get to do: Design, maintain, and execute test cases for APIs, web, and mobile applications. Perform functional, regression, and integration testing across services and applications. Work with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) to validate endpoints, requests, and responses. Apply basic OOP concepts when writing or maintaining automated tests. Execute manual testing for web and mobile apps (UI/UX, cross-browser, cross-platform). Participate in bug reporting, verification, and tracking in tools like Jira or Azure DevOps. Collaborate closely with developers to clarify requirements and reproduce issues. Support the QA team in building automation coverage and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines. Contribute to QA documentation: test plans, test reports, and checklists. What You need to know: Practical experience with API testing. 0.5 - 1 year of hands-on experience in web testing (desktop & responsive) and mobile app testing (iOS/Android). Knowledge of HTTP, JSON, XML, and authentication methods (OAuth, JWT, API keys). Hands-on experience in web testing (desktop & responsive) and mobile app testing (iOS/Android). Familiarity with at least one programming or scripting language. Understanding of basic OOP principles (inheritance, encapsulation, abstraction, polymorphism). Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (Jira, TestRail). Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business, LinkedIn Learning or O’Reilly, and a budget for external training. Gym allowance. Corporate English lessons.
